description.value: You can hear something rattling inside but there seems to be no way to open it.
It floats quietly, yet emits a dim light. You can hear something rattling inside but there seems to be no way to open it.
Supposedly it shows the way to a hidden fairy treasure.
It was created by Tibia's finest vintagers for the celebration of 20 years of Tibia.
It displays a large letter T and was awarded during the festivities of Tibia's 20th anniversary.
It displays the number 20 and was awarded during the festivities of Tibia's 20th anniversary.
This is a Shaper crystal used by their ancient imbuing shrines. It has been separated from its shrine. Without a crystal, it cannot focus any energy.
You can see the other side through it.
The rune has become inert and will need some hours to regain full strength.
